key: "Client Archive"
en: "Client Archive"
ja: 「クライアント記録」

key: Unlocked the door with the Archive Key.
en: Unlocked the door with the Archive Key.
ja: アーカイブキーでドアの鍵を開けた。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: "Lower-Level Arena Access"
en: "Lower-Level Arena Access"
ja: 「地下アリーナ通路」

key: "Boys' Room"
en: "Boys' Room"
ja: 「男子部屋」

key: SHELLY: U-um.... We probably shouldn't go in there...
en: SHELLY: U-um.... We probably shouldn't go in there...
ja: シェリー: う、うぅ……たぶん、入っちゃだめだと思う……

key: "Girls' Room"
en: "Girls' Room"
ja: 「女子部屋」

key: SHELLY: H-hey, maybe we really shouldn't...
en: SHELLY: H-hey, maybe we really shouldn't...
ja: シェリー: ね、ねえ、やっぱりやめといたほうが……

key: SHELLY: U-um, \PN?
en: SHELLY: U-um, \PN?
ja: シェリー: あ、あの、\PN?

key: What are you doing?
en: What are you doing?
ja: 何をしている?

key: Have you no regard for procedure?
en: Have you no regard for procedure?
ja: 手続きというものを、どう考えているんだ?

key: Then I have no regard for you.
en: Then I have no regard for you.
ja: それなら、貴様のことなど知ったことか。

key: Hmph.
en: Hmph.
ja: ふん。

key: This area is strictly off limits to absolutely everybody except us!
en: This area is strictly off limits to absolutely everybody except us!
ja: このエリアは、私たち以外は誰であろうと完全に立ち入り禁止だ!

key: Beating us is off limits too!
en: Beating us is off limits too!
ja: 私たちを倒すのも禁止よ!

key: Vandal!
en: Vandal!
ja: 蛮族め!

key: COMMONS LOCK DISENGAGED
en: COMMONS LOCK DISENGAGED
ja: 共用エリアのロック解除

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やっほー! ジムに着いたみたいね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムはグランドホールに直結してるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでも相談できるのよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それで……

key: AME: So you're at Dr. Connal's Orphanage, right?
en: AME: So you're at Dr. Connal's Orphanage, right?
ja: アメ: 今いるのは、コナール博士の孤児院なのね?

key: Several of the kids there are prodigious battlers--
en: Several of the kids there are prodigious battlers--
ja: あそこの子供たちには、バトルの天才が何人かいてね――

key: They were referred to us and managed to beat out all of the competition, so they got their positions.
en: They were referred to us and managed to beat out all of the competition, so they got their positions.
ja: こっちに紹介されて、他の候補を全員退けてポジションを勝ち取ったのよ。

key: Because of that, we actually installed an arena in the Orphanage's basement.
en: Because of that, we actually installed an arena in the Orphanage's basement.
ja: それで、孤児院の地下に実際にアリーナを設置したの。

key: I'm sure you'll see it shortly--
en: I'm sure you'll see it shortly--
ja: もうすぐ見られると思うけど――

key: Huh? They're not accepting battles because the arena is being repaired?
en: Huh? They're not accepting battles because the arena is being repaired?
ja: え? アリーナが修理中だから、バトルを受け付けてない?

key: That's exactly how it was a few months ago...
en: That's exactly how it was a few months ago...
ja: それ、数ヶ月前とまったく同じ状況ね……

key: I thought I handled that.
en: I thought I handled that.
ja: あれは片づけたと思ってたんだけど。

key: Dr. Connal might be lying.
en: Dr. Connal might be lying.
ja: コナール博士がうそをついてるのかもしれない。

key: I'll have to talk to him about that.
en: I'll have to talk to him about that.
ja: そのことは、彼と話をしないとね。

key: Well, whenever you are allowed to fight them, Noel will probably be your first opponent from there.
en: Well, whenever you are allowed to fight them, Noel will probably be your first opponent from there.
ja: まあ、戦えるようになったら、最初の相手はたぶんノエルね。

key: He trains Normal-type Pokémon, but he was also allowed to use his ace, Clefable, as a wildcard.
en: He trains Normal-type Pokémon, but he was also allowed to use his ace, Clefable, as a wildcard.
ja: ノーマルタイプのポケモンを育ててるけど、切り札のピクシーもワイルドカードとして使っていいことになってる。

key: Be careful for that. It can get very big, very fast.
en: Be careful for that. It can get very big, very fast.
ja: あれには気をつけて。あっという間に大きくなるから。

key: Noel's other Pokémon are very well-rounded on their own, but he mainly only does one thing with them.
en: Noel's other Pokémon are very well-rounded on their own, but he mainly only does one thing with them.
ja: ノエルの他のポケモンはどれもバランスがいいけど、彼はだいたい一つのことしかしないの。

key: When you fight him, you might try to find opportunities to exploit changes in the environment, or anything else that's abnormal for what he's used to.
en: When you fight him, you might try to find opportunities to exploit changes in the environment, or anything else that's abnormal for what he's used to.
ja: 彼と戦うときは、フィールドの変化とか、彼が慣れていない異常な状況を突くチャンスを探すといいかも。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールの誰も、電話に出ないみたい……
